note: Provisional defaults for the comprehensive learner report. Every figure in a report is computed by code from stored scores; the language model only phrases them, and its text is rejected unless it is supported by those figures. A teacher should review these thresholds before the pilot.
disclaimer: This is a summary of practice in this app. It is not a test, a certificate or an assessment of English level, and it does not diagnose anything. Results depend on the microphone, the room and the day.
